product.name: AI Shopping Engine
product.description: An AI-driven platform that personalizes online shopping experiences by analyzing visitor behavior to increase conversions and average order value.

product.name: Abandoned Cart Recovery
product.description: A tool that uses AI to re-engage visitors who abandon their shopping carts by sending personalized nudges and time-sensitive offers to encourage purchase completion.

product.name: Bestoffer Products
product.description: An application that highlights top offers and deals on the homepage to increase visibility and facilitate quicker purchase decisions.

product.name: Bestsellers Automation
product.description: A system that automatically identifies and highlights best-selling products on an e-commerce site to guide customers toward popular items.

product.name: Shop By Category
product.description: A feature that organizes products into intuitive categories to simplify navigation and improve the shopping experience.
